messages:
Maria G.: Heads up — CloudWave asked us to open a new APAC region (apac-east-2) on the marketplace before next quarter. They need quota + a marketplace listing slot.

Kevin L.: Do we have spare quota in apac-east-2 for GPUs? which GPU family are they after?

Sinead (CloudWave): Hi! They want 8x A100-80GB initially, maybe burst to 16. Also need marketplace entitlement in the next 3 weeks for our joint PR schedule.

Oliver P.: A100-80GB is fine but we need to confirm node types and AZs. Are they ok with 2-zone distribution?

Maria G.: @Oliver P. yes, partner prefers 2-zone for redundancy. Ops asked for expected sustained vCPU and memory too — share any perf targets.

Sinead (CloudWave): Perf target: avg 50 req/s across the pool, p95 latency under 250ms for short-chat workloads. Sustained vCPU ~512, memory ~2TB across nodes.

Kevin L.: Noted. I'll open a quota request ticket with cloud provider. Can someone confirm the required billing SKUs for marketplace entitlement?

Ashley R.: We'll need an updated MSA amendment for the marketplace listing + data processing addendum. Tagging legal review SLA: 5 business days once we get the draft.

Maria G.: Action items: (1) Kevin to file quota request (2) Oliver to validate infra sizing + AZ plan (3) Ashley to prep legal checklist (4) Sinead to provide marketplace listing assets.

Kevin L.: Filing ticket now — reference: `Q-1935-AE2` — ETA from provider is ~7–10 business days for quota increase. I'll request priority for partner.

Oliver P.: Quick infra note: if we go A100-80GB we should reserve a mix of 4x A100 nodes + 2x spare nodes for burst. I'll post a proposed node pool YAML in a follow-up.

Sinead (CloudWave): Sending assets tonight — logos, pricing tiers, and a 1-pager. Also, can we line up a short tech call with infra next Tue?

Maria G.: Yes to Tue. @Oliver P. can you do Tue 09:00 PT?

Oliver P.: I can. Adding to calendar.

GCP Marketplace Bot: Marketplace entitlement checklist created: ticket MP-4821. Please attach listing assets and entitlements to MP-4821.

Ashley R.: I'll start the MSA amendment draft and drop it in MP-4821. Quick Q: are they requesting any custom data residency terms?

Sinead (CloudWave): They want logs retained in-region for 90 days and a standard SOC2 attestation. No additional bespoke residency controls.

Maria G.: Great. I'll track MP-4821 and Q-1935-AE2. Will update the PR timeline once quota confirmed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Kevin L.: Follow-up: provider responded with a preliminary approval for 8 A100s, pending capacity check — they asked for an expected first-week consumption number.

Sinead (CloudWave): First-week expected compute: ~20% of provisioned capacity, ramping to 60% by week 4.

Maria G.: Perfect — Kevin, pass that to the provider. I'll set a canary launch plan for the marketplace entry after capacity is validated.

Oliver P.: I'll upload the node pool YAML to MP-4821 and include a config snippet for autoscaling thresholds:

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: NodePool
spec:
  minSize: 4
  maxSize: 16
  gpu: A100-80GB
  zones: ["zone-a", "zone-b"]
  scalePolicy: cpu > 60% for 10m
```

Maria G.: Closing loop — next sync Tue after infra call. If anything urgent ping me or update MP-4821.

Sinead (CloudWave): Thanks all, appreciate the fast turnaround :rocket:
